_comment: Achievements (scheduler/achievements.ts): earned once per player per run, at the moment named in `when`, and told with a push notice. `hidden` ones show as a sealed medallion, their name and how to earn them unknown, until earned. Each has its own picture (`art`, achievement/<id>, drawn by tools/art/generate.py).

first_defense.name: Shield of the Village
first_defense.description: Beat a horde at one of your villages.

field_victory.name: Hold the Ford
field_victory.description: Beat a horde in a field battle with an army holding its road.

captives_freed.name: Unchained
captives_freed.description: Free captives from the camp that holds them.

ember_found.name: Keeper of the Flame
ember_found.description: Find Svarog's Ember in an ancient site.

hero_quest.name: Errand Rider
hero_quest.description: Bring your hero home from a quest.

army_quest.name: Warleader
army_quest.description: Finish a quest your hero leads the army on.

fort_built.name: Palisade
fort_built.description: Raise a fort in the field.

bridge_stage.name: Stone upon Stone
bridge_stage.description: Raise a stage of the Kalinov Bridge.

hero_fallen.name: Carried Home
hero_fallen.description: Your hero was struck down in battle, and lived.

hordes_united.name: Many Banners
hordes_united.description: Stand against two hordes in one battle.

stronghold_sacked.name: To the Heart of Nav
stronghold_sacked.description: Sack a stronghold beyond the border.

village_ruined.name: Ashes
village_ruined.description: Lose a village to a horde.

boat_built.name: The River Road
boat_built.description: See a boat built at a shipyard.

victory.name: Dawn over Prav
victory.description: Hold the Holy City through Ritual Night.
